notes.title: Update 05/17
notes.notes:
Update
-

[previewyoutube=MTpKYZai8Bc;full][/previewyoutube]

Telescope magnification can be changed in VR.
I think some user could suffer buggy frame drop after grabbing scope. Don't touch it in that case.

Oculus performance is fixed. but still blurry. I will try adding in-game supersampling option for Oculus.
Oculus Air link image quality is way better than USB cabled link/Virtual desktop.
Oculus play has unique bug- it take 30 seconds to return to start room.

 3 towns added

NPC accessory can be un equipped in Non VR.

When Healing plask get impact, it explode and heal nearby characters. 
You have to attach it to toolbelt because they explode with small impact.

LOD optimized for GPU. it would noticeable.


Changes
-

Guards are way impatient than before.
VR harpoon fishing gun wind speed twiced.
Removed harpoon gun air drag so that player can fish in moving ship.
Less drop chance of explosives in boxes of military area.
NPC don't talk each other when they are too far from player.
Toolbelt re attaching distance of VR is shortened.
Changed logic of player melee weapon.
Un-collected tax accumulates.
NPC can rotate attack. they fight way better than before.
Crime rate grows when you get out of shop while stolen item is attached to toolbelt.
Ship boarding time changed from 10 seconds to 25 seconds, giving more time of ranged combat.
Guards may attack you when you steal their weapon.
Player made item price twiced.
Changed some NPC cosmetic.



Minor fix
-
Guards don't tend to spin in group.
Hitting wounded NPC is crime now.

notes.title: Non-VR update
notes.notes:
Keyboard and mouse input version is uploaded. 
The game file size is twice of before, but you can select VR and Non-VR version without any efforts.

This is 30min playthrough of tutorial part.

[previewyoutube=CSgwg8rFDCY;full][/previewyoutube]



While updating Non-VR, VR version also update below.


 Update
-VR controller have sit button so that player in chair don't need to bow to grab items on the floor.
-Japanese translation for some vitals parts.
-Added ship ambience.



Change
-Vive and MR key mapping changed.
-Player can not save in combat
-You can draw tool belt in moving ship. it sticks to ship. 
-Removed the concept of civilian private zone.
-Guards are less patient for trespassing.
-Ship rotates faster
-Lantern is brighter.
-Harpoon gun velocity works well in moving ship so that fishing in the ship is possible.
-NPC rotate faster when combat





Minor bug fix
-Remove error when saving and loading in tutorial
-Dead body don't speak
-Player don't fall below room of starting game when HMD start below the floor.
-When player die in ship battle, it is counted as loose.
-Bullet rewards of contract don't physics explode.

notes.title: Non VR version is going to be merged into this title.
notes.notes:
Because Steam don't allow making another store page for Non VR version, VR and Non VR version going to  be merged in this store page.
The way of executing VR client is not defined yet. Free DLC, making beta branch for VR, selecting exe file when start, every way has it's own downside. 
While I am finding best way of executing both VR and NonVR in one game title, this game sometimes not executable and multiple updates may start without reason. 

Stable executable of Non VR client going to be uploaded on April 21

Two type of hair accessory added. you can take NPC hair accessory by grabbing calf.
Save file comparability: Only towns you did not accessed has hair accessory.

Each item category has different hitting sound.

Grenade added. It explodes 3~5 seconds after its pin removed.

You can talk to near NPC by shooting grapple hook.

New contract- Finding lost cargo with crane added. I made this long before but disabled until now. I don't remember reason. Each lost cargo and delivery cargo remember contract ID.

Contract level system added. you have to pass test to increase contract level.
Better ship requires higher contract level.
All ships are reballanced.





Changes- 
When you kill town NPC, town regenerate another random NPC next time loaded.
NPC watch your eye, not your character head.
Military zones are protected with palisades and there are expensive chests. guards will be clever next in update.
Ship sink animation added.
Bullet reward from contract increased.
Handle collision of production machine cover became bigger. not tested at all
Bullet effected by less gravity.

Minor bug fixed-
Night ambient changes on time
NPC job information shown properly.

notes.title: Update 03/18 - Oculus support, Alix grip
notes.notes:
Alix grip:

[previewyoutube=eZhdwQh-Sjo;full][/previewyoutube]

When player fire grapple hook to item within 3m, item move toward to player.
If player press grip button right after that, that item is grabbed ignoring distance.
This does not work with already attached item and item chest.


Oculus support: 

Oculus controller is default. If you are using vive, you have to enable "use vive controller" option in start room.
Index and MR controller also changed but not tested.
Oculus input is tested with Quest 2 virtual desktop and wi-fi. further hotfix can be done if there is a link cable issue arriving tomorrow.




Changes-
Items attached to toolbelt don't collide with world items. Collision returns when player grab it again. but item chest does not work in this way.
Machineguns without magazine can fire last shot if there is a last bullet inside cylinder.



Minor bug fix- 
NPC's walking below water in some towns is fixed.
Ship interface not showing in specific rotation of ship is fixed.
Most chest of Valencia bug fixed.
NPC bag loose physics so that dead body not explode.

notes.title: Update 03/04
notes.notes:
Survival mode- If you enable this, you have to eat food to survive. Eating un-purchased food counted as crime. So it is important you collect food from farm.
Royal shop sells bread with expensive price. 
If your save file is non survival mode, you can enable after load by clicking system-enable survival mode button.
When you lose fight, you lost food gauge. If you die with 0 food gauge, that means permanent death.

Investment- You can invest Peji from royal shop. you can collect tax every two days if you invested more than 5000 peji. Investment interface say you will get access to forbidden zones but that is not updated yet.

Reroll contract- you can reroll contract. You can reroll only nearby town contract.





Improvement- Frame drop happened every 30 second removed. Instead, it happens one time whenever you move 1.2km distance.
Royal shop item shows icon.

Added- jump key is bind to right controller. It would be changed in future. 

Changes- Small ships move faster. you should sell and buy your ship to apply update.
Cascade movement is default option.


Next update going to be pickpocket and sneak system, openable tutorial books, ship stat rebalance, companion interaction.

notes.title: Update 02/22
notes.notes:
Crash fix: NPC melee attack don't use physicsX so it does not generate crashes anymore.
Optimized CPU surge when ending and starting combat

Critical bug fix: Guards lost their weapons when player ship go far from town. It is fixed.
Player could not win ship battle. It is fixed.

Major update: Weather changes, some North Africa towns and animals.

Convenience improve : Magazines attached to weapon or toolbelt re-attaches to its post parent when load game.
Player's leg don't kick items.
Suspicious level go down to zero when player die.
Fish not likely to fly to the sky.
Player height change option added to start room book.
Cascade movement option added. This option is good for VR sick.
Play gun dry click sound when there is no bullet but cocked.
Magazines with zero bullet don't show bullet on its entrance.
Fixed duel grip on ship.
NPCs fight better in melee.
Player ship cannon calculates proper gravity.






Changes: Player HP 220% increased.
Player have to sweep faster to apply melee attack damage.
Item price for hunted animal changed, Wildlife collection and ocean collection donation give 15 times bigger price.
NPC gunner accuracy lowered,
Distance of starting ship boarding become longer. 

New bug found: player griped item move forward 50cm after ship battle. Fixed on 02/23
Player can not handle gun slider when ship is moving fast.
